```{r preprocessing}

library(caret)
library(dplyr)
library(fastDummies) 

# read in data
nfl_data <- read.csv(
  "nfl_2019.csv", 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, 
  na.strings = c("NA", "", "NULL", "-")
)

# keep only plays that are clearly passes or runs
missing_indices <- which(is.na(nfl_data$pass_length) & is.na(nfl_data$run_location))
nfl_data <- nfl_data[-missing_indices, ]

# Initialize
nfl_data$play_call <- NA_character_

# PASS PLAYS:
# short left pass
nfl_data$play_call[
  nfl_data$pass_length == "short" & nfl_data$pass_location == "left"
] <- "short left pass"

# short right pass
nfl_data$play_call[
  nfl_data$pass_length == "short" & nfl_data$pass_location == "right"
] <- "short right pass"

# deep left pass
nfl_data$play_call[
  nfl_data$pass_length == "deep" & nfl_data$pass_location == "left"
] <- "deep left pass"

# deep right pass
nfl_data$play_call[
  nfl_data$pass_length == "deep" & nfl_data$pass_location == "right"
] <- "deep right pass"

# RUN PLAYS:
# left run
nfl_data$play_call[
  nfl_data$run_location == "left"
] <- "left run"

# right run
nfl_data$play_call[
  nfl_data$run_location == "right"
] <- "right run"

# Optionally drop plays that don't fit any of the 6 labels
# (e.g., passes to middle or runs up the middle)
nfl_data <- nfl_data[!is.na(nfl_data$play_call), ]

# make play_call a factor (useful for classification)
nfl_data$play_call <- factor(
  nfl_data$play_call,
  levels = c(
    "short left pass",
    "short right pass",
    "deep left pass",
    "deep right pass",
    "left run",
    "right run"
  )
)

# The new target
y_target <- nfl_data$play_call

# filter to classification features
x_features <- c("posteam", "side_of_field", "shotgun", "no_huddle",
                "yrdln", "down", "goal_to_go", "qtr",
                "game_seconds_remaining", "posteam_score")
x_data <- nfl_data[x_features]

x_data$side_of_field <- ifelse(
  x_data$posteam == x_data$side_of_field,
  "Theirs",
  "Opposing"
)

# one hot encode categorical columns
categ_cols <- c("posteam", "side_of_field", "yrdln", "down")
x_data <- dummy_cols(x_data, select_columns = categ_cols, remove_first_dummy = FALSE)
x_data <- x_data[, !(names(x_data) %in% categ_cols)] 

# normalize continuous features
continuous_cols <- c("game_seconds_remaining", "posteam_score")
x_data[, continuous_cols] <- scale(x_data[, continuous_cols])

# add bias term to create final X matrix
x_data$bias <- 1
X_all <- as.matrix(x_data)
storage.mode(X_all) <- "numeric"

# split data into training and test data
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(y_target, p = .75, list = FALSE, times = 1)
X_train <- X_all[trainIndex,]
X_test <- X_all[-trainIndex,]
```

```{r}

Y_all <- model.matrix(~ play_call - 1, data = nfl_data)

Y_train <- Y_all[trainIndex, ]
Y_test  <- Y_all[-trainIndex, ]

Y_train <- as.matrix(Y_train)
storage.mode(Y_train) <- "numeric"
Y_test <- as.matrix(Y_test)
storage.mode(Y_test) <- "numeric"

head(Y_train)
```

```{r mlp setup}

eta <- 0.001 # step size
q <- 10 # hidden nodes

n <- nrow(X_train)
d <- ncol(X_train)
k <- ncol(Y_train)

W1 <- matrix(rnorm(d * q), nrow = d, ncol = q)
W2 <- matrix(rnorm(q * k), nrow = q, ncol = k)  

# leaky relu (was getting issues with normal relu)
leaky_relu <- function(x, alpha = 0.01) {
  ifelse(x > 0, x, alpha * x)
}

# softmax
softmax <- function(x) {
  # x: (n x k)
  x_shift <- x - apply(x, 1, max)  # numerical stability
  exp_x <- exp(x_shift)
  exp_x / rowSums(exp_x)
}

# forward pass func
forward_pass <- function(X, W1, W2) {
  H_net <- X %*% W1              
  H_out <- leaky_relu(H_net)
  O_net <- H_out %*% W2          
  Y_pred <- softmax(O_net)       
  
  list(Y_pred = Y_pred, H_out = H_out, H_net = H_net)
}
```

```{r mlp}
errors <- numeric()
epochs <- 200

# Backprop
for (epoch in 1:epochs) {
  fwd <- forward_pass(X_train, W1, W2)
  
  delta_2 <- fwd$Y_pred - Y_train
  dW2 <- t(fwd$H_out) %*% delta_2 / n
  
  # Leaky ReLU derivative
  leaky_relu_deriv <- ifelse(fwd$H_net > 0, 1, 0.01)  
  delta_1 <- (delta_2 %*% t(W2)) * leaky_relu_deriv
  dW1 <- t(X_train) %*% delta_1 / n
  
  W2 <- W2 - eta * dW2
  W1 <- W1 - eta * dW1
  
  epsilon <- 1e-15
  L <- -mean(rowSums(Y_train * log(fwd$Y_pred + epsilon)))
  errors <- c(errors, L)
}

cat("Initial Loss:", round(errors[1], 4), "\n")
cat("Final Loss:", round(errors[length(errors)], 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# evaluate
# Make predictions on test set
fwd_test <- forward_pass(X_test, W1, W2)

# Predicted classes
predicted_classes <- apply(fwd_test$Y_pred, 1, which.max)
true_classes <- apply(Y_test, 1, which.max)

# Calculate accuracy
accuracy <- mean(predicted_classes == true_classes)
cat("Test Accuracy:", accuracy)

# Confusion matrix
conf_matrix <- table(Predicted = predicted_classes, Actual = true_classes)
print(conf_matrix)
```
